summary: Improve CRM data quality and pipeline governance with practical scorecards, controls, and dashboards. Enroll to strengthen forecast trust.
lede: CRM data quality and pipeline governance is the practice of assessing and controlling customer records and sales pipeline data. For professionals in CRM, sales operations, and commercial reporting, it supports more reliable records and accountable pipeline reporting. Participants practice profiling fields, detecting duplicates, setting validation and stage controls, tracing data handoffs, and monitoring exceptions in dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who already work with CRM, sales operations, or commercial reporting and now need stronger control over data quality, governance, and pipeline accountability.
prerequisites: You should bring a working knowledge of CRM structures, pipeline stages, and basic reporting concepts. A laptop is required for workshop exercises, and access to Excel or a BI dashboard tool will be useful for practical tasks. If you want to adapt the outputs after class, bring examples of your own CRM fields, pipeline stage list, or reporting template, subject to your organization’s confidentiality rules.
